name: Floriana Lemieux
description: Floriana Lemieux is a human commoner who operates Salon Lemieux, a popular North Ward salon providing dermatology, hair, and nail services. She sports a dramatic jet-studded black beehive that stands ever so slightly higher than her twin sister's.
ideals: Excellence: Maintaining the finest beauty and wellness treatments in the North Ward.
Pride: Outdoing her sister in both business success and hairstyle height.
bonds: Salon Lemieux (W3) and her clientele of fashionable ladies and gentlemen.
Her bitter rivalry with her twin sister, Gloriana.
flaws: Extremely petty and hot-tempered when it comes to her ongoing, loud public feud with her twin sister.
speech_patterns: Dramatic, sharp, and quick to voice complaints, especially regarding her sister's business or personal history.
mannerisms: Adjusts her towering jet-black beehive studded with crystals, glares across the street at her sister's establishment, and passionately discusses fashion treatments.

relationships.name: Gloriana Lemieux
relationships.relationship: Twin Sister / Business Competitor / Bitter Rival

motivations: To run a premier beauty salon and utterly outshine her twin sister in the North Ward fashion scene.
knowledge: Expertise in beauty treatments, cosmetics, North Ward gossip, and neighborhood noble scandals overheard at the salon.
gm_notes: Floriana Lemieux serves as a colorful, dramatic local shopkeeper across from Trollskull Manor. She can be used for comedic neighborhood bickerings, beauty services, or as a source of accidental gossip regarding noble secrets overheard during salon treatments.
